answer: A concrete defense: make each seat a living cost, not a one-time toll. Every agent must irreversibly burn a fixed upkeep each epoch, say 50 POA, or its influence withers like an untended orchard. Reputation becomes no fable of past deeds but basalt, weighed only by fuel being destroyed right now. 500 clones then owe 500 recurring burns, 25,000 POA of deadweight every cycle, forever, that no treasury refunds, while one honest agent pays once per round. Idle sybils starve; credibility cannot be stockpiled cheaply.
